parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key you generate for this attempt (e.g. a UUID). Optional: without it every call is a new request. Resending the same key (after a timeout or network cut) returns the original response instead of creating a second operation; the same key with a different body, or while the first call is still in progress, returns 409.

example_prompt: Charge my customer by mobile money with SasPay from my checkout.

otp.description: OTP PRÉ-paiement, uniquement pour les réseaux qui l'exigent (Orange Money Côte d'Ivoire et Burkina Faso : le client compose un code USSD AVANT de payer, cf. GET /pricing/my-rates/). Sans lui sur un réseau qui l'exige : 422 prepayment_otp_missing. À ne pas confondre avec l'OTP reçu par SMS APRÈS le push (Coris Bénin, Wizall Sénégal), qui passe par /payments/{id}/confirm-otp/.

merchant.description: UUID du marchand visé. Ignoré pour une clé API (toujours vous-même) ; pour un token dashboard gérant plusieurs marchands, résout la boutique visée si le header X-Merchant-Id n'est pas fourni.

fee_charge_mode.description: ADD_ON : les frais s'ajoutent au montant débité au client. DEDUCTED : les frais sont déduits du montant net reversé au marchand. Défaut : configuration du marchand.

preferred_gateway.description: Code gateway à privilégier si plusieurs sont éligibles pour ce réseau

gotchas: Always check checkout_url in the response: for Wave, Orange Money, Djamo and cards you must redirect the customer to it; only when it is empty was a request pushed to the customer's phone.

Networks that need a pre-payment OTP (Orange Money Côte d'Ivoire and Burkina Faso: the customer dials a USSD code first) require the otp field, otherwise 422 prepayment_otp_missing. This is not the post-push SMS OTP, which goes through confirm_otp.

Send an Idempotency-Key (one UUID per payment attempt, reused on retries): without it a network retry creates a second real payment. Reusing a key with a different body, or while the first call is still running, returns 409.
Amounts are decimal strings ("2500.00"), never floats.
To know beforehand whether a network needs the pre-payment OTP (and show the right USSD instructions), read otp_required / otp_instructions from GET /pricing/my-rates/.
Valid network codes per country and the expected customer.phone format are listed on the docs' formats page (/api-reference/reference/formats).
A 400 validation error has another shape than business errors: error is a map of field names to messages ({"field": ["message"]}), not {message, code}.
open_questions: How SasPay tells sandbox from production on the same host, https://api.saspay.me (sandbox test runs and the production OpenAPI both use it): key type or account mode — not documented in this spec set.
